trip.title: Robert & Geo Take On Yellowstone & Grand Teton
trip.subtitle: A 5-Day Great American Camper Adventure
trip.routeSummary: Salt Lake City loop through Alpine, Grand Teton, Yellowstone, and West Yellowstone, and back to Salt Lake City

route.note: The master map shows the point-to-point navigation route (769 mi / 13h 23m). Day-by-day planned mileage below totals about 843 miles because it also includes driving inside the parks between stops.

days.title: SFO → SLC → Alpine, Wyoming

timeline.desc: Depart SFO on DL1331.
Land at SLC. Collect luggage and travel to Millcreek.
Grocery and supply run near Millcreek — park stores are smaller and more expensive.
Pick up the Cruise America RV at 4125 S State St. Complete the vehicle walkthrough, document damage, test utilities, and confirm return requirements.
Drive north through Idaho and US-89 into Alpine, Wyoming.

stay.name: Alpine Valley RV Resort
stay.details: Pull-through site · check-in after 2:00 PM · check-out 10:00 AM · no generators.

days.warning: RV pickup can run as late as 4:00 PM, which may push arrival at Alpine Valley into the evening. Keep dinner simple and confirm the campground's late-arrival procedure before the trip.

days.title: Grand Teton National Park

timeline.desc: Break camp at Alpine Valley RV Resort and depart, well ahead of the 10:00 AM checkout.
Drive Alpine to Jackson to Moose entrance (~46 mi, ~45 min).
Walk: Mormon Row Historic District & Moulton Barn. Flat, short walk; gravel lot fits the RV. Morning side-light on the barn is the classic shot.
Drive to Schwabacher Landing (~5 mi, ~15 min).
Walk: Schwabacher Landing. Flat 0.5-mi trail/boardwalk, 30-45 min. Small lot, arrive before 8 AM. Best reflections before the wind picks up.
Drive to Jenny Lake (~8 mi, ~15 min).
Walk: Jenny Lake shoreline from the large South Jenny Lake lot. Optional: boat + 1-mi round-trip hike to Hidden Falls adds ~1.5 hours.
Drive north to Oxbow Bend (~18 mi, ~25 min).
Photo stop: Oxbow Bend. Roadside pullout, no hike. Midday still gives Mount Moran views and wildlife odds; dawn is the classic glassy reflection.
Drive to Jackson Lake Junction; lunch break.
Drive the Rockefeller Parkway to Flagg Ranch (~20 mi, ~25 min).
Arrive Headwaters Campground at Flagg Ranch, well ahead of the 2:00 PM check-in.

highlights: John D. Rockefeller Jr. Memorial Parkway
days.fromTrail: Oxbow Bend is best at dawn — the light is soft and the river is calm. Schwabacher Landing is just south on US-89. Mormon Row is one of the most-photographed spots in America — the Moulton Barn framed by the Teton range is extraordinary. Sequence these stops south-to-north so the drive to Flagg Ranch flows naturally.

stay.name: Headwaters Campground at Flagg Ranch
stay.details: Grand Teton National Park · Site 317, 300s · water, sewer, 50A electric · check-in 2:00 PM · check-out 11:00 AM.

days.cancellation: Full refund if cancelled by August 14. No refund after August 15. Verify the policy directly with the campground.
optionalStops: Hidden Falls (via boat or trail from Jenny Lake)

days.title: South Yellowstone → Canyon

timeline.desc: Break camp at Headwaters/Flagg Ranch and depart, well ahead of the 11:00 AM checkout.
Drive to the South Entrance and on to Lewis Falls (~14 mi total, ~30 min).
Photo stop: Lewis Falls. Roadside overlook, no hike. Small pullout.
Drive to West Thumb Geyser Basin (~13 mi, ~20 min).
Walk: West Thumb Geyser Basin. Flat boardwalk loop, ~0.5 mi / 30-45 min. Large paved lot fits the RV. Geysers steam right at the lake's edge.
Drive along the lakeshore toward Fishing Bridge/Lake Village (~21 mi, ~30 min) - passes tonight's campsite.
Walk: Lake Village / Bridge Bay marina stroll and coffee break.
Drive to Mud Volcano (~6 mi, ~10 min).
Walk: Mud Volcano & Dragon's Mouth Spring. Flat boardwalk loop, ~0.6 mi / 20-30 min.
Drive north through Hayden Valley (~8 mi) - budget 30+ min for bison jams.
Drive to Canyon Village / Artist Point (~10 mi, ~20 min).
Walk: Artist Point & Lower Falls overlooks, lunch at Canyon Village. Signature shot of the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone.
Drive south back through Hayden Valley and Mud Volcano to Fishing Bridge (~24 mi, ~35-40 min).
Arrive Fishing Bridge RV Park, check in and set up camp.

days.fromTrail: West Thumb Geyser Basin is directly on your route after the South Entrance — geysers sitting at the lake edge is a genuinely strange and beautiful sight. Don't skip it. Artist Point at Canyon is the signature overlook: the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone with its vivid orange and yellow canyon walls dropping to the Lower Falls. The rainbow in the mist is visible in morning light.

stay.name: Fishing Bridge RV Park
stay.address: 22 Fishing Bridge RV Park Rd, Yellowstone National Park, WY 82190
stay.details: RV only · 30 ft max · check-in after 1:00 PM · check-out 11:00 AM.

days.cancellation: $25 fee after July 18. Deposit forfeited after August 10. Verify in the reservation portal.

days.title: Northern Yellowstone → West Yellowstone

timeline.desc: Break camp at Fishing Bridge and depart, well ahead of the 11:00 AM checkout.
Drive to Canyon Village and pass through, no stop (~16 mi, ~25 min).
Drive to Tower Fall via Dunraven Pass (~19 mi, ~45 min, slower mountain road).
Walk: Tower Fall. Short walk to the overlook, moderate lot.
Drive + wildlife: Lamar Valley, 10-15 mi in and back out. Best wildlife road in the park; budget the full hour.
Drive back to Tower Junction, then to Mammoth Hot Springs (~18 mi, ~35 min).
Walk: Mammoth Hot Springs lower terraces, flat boardwalk, 30-45 min. Upper terrace loop is a narrow one-way drive, +30 min.
Drive to Norris Geyser Basin (~21 mi, ~40 min). Optional — skip to Madison if behind schedule.
Walk: Norris Geyser Basin, Porcelain Basin loop, flat boardwalk, ~0.5 mi / 30-45 min.
Drive via Madison Junction to Old Faithful (~30 mi, ~45 min combined).
Old Faithful: eruptions every 60-110 min, posted at the visitor center. Lunch at the general store while waiting.
Drive to the Fairy Falls trailhead / Midway Geyser Basin (~9 mi, ~15 min).
Hike: Grand Prismatic Spring via the Fairy Falls overlook. Real hike — 1.6-mi round trip with elevation gain, ~45-60 min. Shows the rainbow colors the lake-level boardwalk does not.
Optional: Firehole Lake Drive, one-way loop past Great Fountain Geyser (~3 mi, ~15-20 min). Skip if past 2:00 PM.
Drive via Madison to the West Entrance and West Yellowstone (~21 mi, ~35 min).
Arrive Yellowstone Park/West Gate KOA, check in and set up camp.

days.fromTrail: Leave Fishing Bridge by 7 AM — this is the big day. Lamar Valley bison will stop your vehicle; build buffer time. For Grand Prismatic, the Fairy Falls overlook is the classic aerial view — the boardwalk at lake level doesn't show the colors at all. Norris Geyser Basin is often skipped but is the hottest, most active area in the park: the Porcelain Basin loop is 800 meters and unmissable.

stay.name: Yellowstone Park / West Gate KOA Holiday
stay.address: 3305 Targhee Pass Highway, 6 miles West on US-20, West Yellowstone, MT 59758
stay.details: Back-in site · 30/20A water/electric · check-in 1:00 PM · check-out 11:00 AM · Wi-Fi password revealed in Reservations.

days.cancellation: Call 800-562-7591 by 4:00 PM August 11. Text and email cancellations are not accepted.
days.warning: This is an aggressive day. The planned schedule pencils out to about 8.5-9 hours door to door, but August crowds, Old Faithful's unpredictable eruption timing, and extra wildlife jams commonly push it to 10-12+ hours in practice. Treat Norris and Firehole Lake Drive as the first cuts if you're behind by early afternoon.

days.title: West Yellowstone → SLC → Home

timeline.desc: Leave West Gate KOA. Take US-20 to I-15 south through Idaho.
Return the RV in Millcreek. Refill fuel/propane and complete tank requirements per the rental contract.
Free time in Salt Lake City, or head to the airport and relax before the evening flight.
Depart SLC on DL2762; arrive SFO at 9:59 PM.

highlights: Free afternoon in Salt Lake City
days.warning: The drive from West Yellowstone to Millcreek plus fuel, tank service, cleaning, and traffic leaves limited margin before the 11:00 AM RV return. Confirm whether the return appointment can be adjusted and prepare the RV the previous night.
